name: Kinetiq HIP3StakingManager (kmHYPE)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: This is kmHYPE's staking manager, not kHYPE's. The admin and treasury Safes have no module or guard, but OPERATOR_ROLE is a bare EOA that can call withdrawFromSpot and processL1Operations, and it binds the score.
narrative.detail: kmHYPE is Kinetiq's liquid staking token for HIP-3 markets (Markets by Kinetiq). Roles read live: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANAGER_ROLE sit with a 4-of-8 Safe, TREASURY_ROLE with a separate 4-of-7 Safe, and SENTINEL_ROLE has no holder. A first version checked only DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and rated the target far higher; checking every role found the bare EOA. The same EOA can push a reward or slash report once per validator per 24 h, and there is no sanity checker (address zero), so the size of each push is unbounded. Same 4-of-8 root Safe as kHYPE and mkts. DefiLlama TVL about $48.3M at the 2026-09-17 scouting read.

steps.what: the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
getOwners() on the holder: the signer set (word 2 is the count)
getModulesPaginated(0x1, 50) on the holder: the modules (a module executes without the signatures)
the guard slot of the holder (keccak of guard_manager.guard.address)
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word

# the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0x71f0019cc7fa79e4f42587fb7b9a817d8d2429ec","0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103","latest"]}'
# owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
curl -s -X POST https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<address from the slot>","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"latest"]}'

curl -s -X POST https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<holder>","data":"0xe75235b8"},"latest"]}'
